critical_remarks.issue: The description of the computer vision model architecture lacks clarity and depth, making it difficult to understand the implementation details.
critical_remarks.impact: This impacts the reader's ability to replicate the model and understand the specific components of the architecture.

critical_remarks.issue: The comparison of results with external datasets lacks a detailed analysis of the discrepancies between the model's performance and the original authors' results.
critical_remarks.impact: This limits the understanding of potential factors contributing to differences in performance across datasets.

improvement_suggestions.original_text: Recent computer vision-based approaches for BMI estimation have predominantly been limited to datasets of up to 7,211 full-body images or 14,500 facial images.
improvement_suggestions.improved_version: Current computer vision-based approaches for BMI estimation have primarily utilized datasets with a maximum of 7,211 full-body images or 14,500 facial images.
improvement_suggestions.explanation: Clarifies the focus on existing approaches and their dataset limitations.

improvement_suggestions.original_text: We introduce an automatic image filtering strategy based on posture clustering and person detection to effectively curate the real-world dataset, ensuring the exclusion of unsuitable images.
improvement_suggestions.improved_version: We present an automatic image filtering strategy utilizing posture clustering and person detection to curate the real-world dataset effectively, eliminating unsuitable images.
improvement_suggestions.explanation: Enhances the clarity and flow of the sentence for better readability.

improvement_suggestions.original_text: The base Densenet201 model is pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset, however, we leave all layers trainable during training.
improvement_suggestions.improved_version: The base Densenet201 model is pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset, but all layers remain trainable during training.
improvement_suggestions.explanation: Improves the coherence and consistency of the sentence.

improvement_suggestions.original_text: We track Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) for each epoch but do not use these metrics to guide training.
improvement_suggestions.improved_version: Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) are tracked for each epoch, but these metrics are not utilized to guide training.
improvement_suggestions.explanation: Enhances the clarity and structure of the sentence.
